### God Relented
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/god-relented
Passage: Jonah 3:10
Points:
- God graciously recommissioned Jonah after his initial rebellion so he could preach judgment to Nineveh.
- The Ninevites and their king took God's warning to heart through earnest fasting, sackcloth, and turning from violence.
- The pagan king demonstrated genuine contrition by casting himself completely on the Lord's mercy.
- God freely chooses to relent from announced destruction when sinners genuinely repent.
- Biblical warnings of judgment should move believers to repentance rather than passive resignation.
